claims.quote: The bridge loomed sooner than I expected — a short wooden span over water that chattered and ran bright between damp stones.
claims.value: short wooden footbridge over a shallow, fast creek; damp stones; running water sound

claims.quote: A plank near the left-middle had a gap where a nail had worked loose; it tipped when I pressed it with my toe and made the wood complain.
There were about eight minutes until the bell when we reached the bank.
claims.value: ~8 minutes until bell at scene start

claims.quote: Then Goliath exploded out of the park: tail high, slobber shining at his jowls, bounding as if he'd been waiting to be a dragon that day. He barked, loud and surprised, and his paws sent up the wet scent of the grass.
claims.value: bounds toward children; tail high; loud barking; slobbery; excited/not aggressive

claims.quote: "The rope's on my bike on the porch," I said, and before I fully decided I had already slipped past the helmet, out to where my bike leaned against the rail.
claims.value: Eli's bike parked at loc-eli-house porch (rope stored on bike)

claims.quote: Looping the rope around the oak post at the near bank, I tied three quick hitches and held the free end as a handline.
claims.value: rope used as a handline looped around near-bank post; three hitches; held free end while crossing

claims.quote: Then, following the second idea — a low guide — I threaded the rope across to a squat root on the far bank and cinched it up low, testing the tension.
claims.value: rope used as low guide secured to far-bank root; waist/hip-height guide; tested tension before crossing

claims.quote: Mara froze for half a breath, then did something braver than pretending: she crouched, helmet tilted, and spoke to him in a sing-song voice. "Easy boy, it's only knights with sandwiches today," she said, and patted the ground like she was offering a treaty.
claims.value: Mara soothes/distracts dog with sing-song voice and gentle patting

claims.quote: When I reached the far side and set the Crown of Crumbs down, my hands ached and felt proud for being honest about how scared I was.
claims.value: Eli's practical bravery: crosses using rope handline and low guide; feels pride in having acted despite fear
